artist_scope: none (Tier 3: code-driven; per-frame fan spin; render-instance clones)
character_sheet: A night phantom: three eight-bladed fans crossed at right angles, spinning in place while the machine drifts through blocks to random points, sheds sparks, aims a spark stream at whoever it is hunting and hurts on contact. Arrows cannot hurt it. It dissolves in daylight unless a spawner made it. Pure spin — the fans turn two degrees every rendered frame, forever.

groups.name: fans
groups.phase: 2 degrees per RENDERED FRAME (frame-rate bound, ENT-S-147), wrapping at 359 deg — not per tick
groups.axis: x / y / z (one axis per fan)
groups.plain: fan 1 spins about X, fan 2 about Y, fan 3 about Z, all at the same angle; the angle advances after every draw
groups.math: shape1__fan.xRot = rad(rf1); shape2__fan.yRot = rad(rf1); shape3__fan.zRot = rad(rf1); rf1 += 2 per frame, wrap > 359 -> 0 (RenderInfo.rf1)

behaviour: Each fan is one classic blade drawn eight times at 45-degree steps (the __iN clones under one animated __fan hub) — Slice 4c.
Because the spin is per rendered frame it freezes behind the pause menu and runs faster at high frame rates (recorded, ENT-S-147).
